about: Specialist roles. A project loads one only when a task needs it; the core roles live in ade-method.

roles.name: backend
roles.description: APIs, data and migrations, under the recorded contracts.

roles.name: sysadmin
roles.description: Hosts, access, backups and runbooks; live changes only on the owner's word.

roles.name: security-reviewer
roles.description: Adversarial security review for high-risk changes only; read-only.

roles.name: qa
roles.description: Tests user-facing changes as a user and writes the missing end-to-end tests; never product code.

roles.name: analyst
roles.description: Researches the web and browser-based tools with the browser plugin; read-only by default, cites every source.

roles.name: monitor
roles.description: Wakes on an ALERT: triages read-only, delegates runbook fixes to focus agents, escalates the rest as a work order.

roles.name: support
roles.description: Customer issues for support engineers: reproduce, check known issues, investigate read-only, file bug tickets, draft replies (sent only on approval).
